name: Det Vide Hus
recommendation: There is a small house sandwiched in between larger ones across from the old Royal palace and it makes for a lovely coffee shop. It’s a great place to catch up, they have enough space to sit and work and their snacks and lunch are very good. I am told the coffee is excellent and they do have some nice tea. Sometimes the people pouring even know how to treat white and green tea with respect, though that’s a bit inconsistent (at other times they are happy to burn lovely white tea leaves with boiling water).
